data.title: Build an Admin Dashboard
data.outcome: Organize complex data and actions so people can safely complete management tasks in every key state.

stages.title: Create a stable layout for complex tasks
stages.action: Define the main navigation, current location, and content area.
stages.evidence: Users can find the current section and return to a higher level.

lessons.title: Sidebar
lessons.tagline: Keep navigation in a vertical column beside the content

lessons.title: Menu
lessons.tagline: Help people move between the main sections of a product

lessons.title: Breadcrumb
lessons.tagline: Show the path from a broad section to the current page

stages.title: Make large amounts of data easy to browse and find
stages.action: Implement the needed parts of lists, search, filters, and pagination.
stages.evidence: Users can find a target record and understand its key fields.

lessons.title: Table
lessons.tagline: Compare many records across the same columns

lessons.title: Pagination
lessons.tagline: Move through a large result set in separate pages

lessons.title: Input
lessons.tagline: Let the user enter one line of text

stages.title: Choose the right way to view and edit
stages.action: Choose a drawer, modal, or separate page based on the length of the task.
stages.evidence: Editing preserves necessary context and is not forced into a cramped container.

lessons.title: Drawer
lessons.tagline: Slide in a side panel without leaving the current page

lessons.title: Modal
lessons.tagline: Pause the page for one focused decision or task

lessons.title: Form
lessons.tagline: Collect several fields and submit them as one task

stages.title: Handle loading, empty, and error states
stages.action: Add the main states for data areas.
stages.evidence: Users can tell whether there is no data, data is still loading, or the request failed.

lessons.title: Skeleton
lessons.tagline: Reserve the layout while content is loading

lessons.title: Empty
lessons.tagline: Explain why no data is shown and what to do next

lessons.title: Alert
lessons.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page

lessons.title: Result
lessons.tagline: Explain the final outcome and the next available step

stages.title: Prevent unauthorized and risky actions
stages.action: Limit actions by permission and require clear confirmation for dangerous actions.
stages.evidence: Front-end messaging matches the server's permission result.

lessons.title: Authorization
lessons.tagline: Decide what an authenticated user is allowed to see or change

lessons.title: Popconfirm
lessons.tagline: Ask for confirmation next to the action that caused it

lessons.title: Disabled
lessons.tagline: Show that a control is currently unavailable
